dog.description_text:
Meet Buddy

Buddy is a adorable young dog who's ready to steal your heart! This guy is bursting with personality and charm, making him the perfect addition to any loving home.

Buddy is all about fun and adventure. His playful spirit and boundless energy will keep you entertained as he explores his world with curiosity and excitement. From chasing toys to discovering new nooks and crannies, every day is a new adventure with Buddy by your side.

If you're looking for a lively, loving, and absolutely adorable dog to brighten your life, Buddy is ready to meet you.

This cutie resides at our Westhampton location you can just walk in no appointment needed open Tuesday-Sunday 11am-4pm . If you are interested in meeting them, you can click to submit an online application at Bideawee.org and click on the "Apply for Adoption" Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped and given their age-appropriate vaccines.
